newsitem.title: UK: Thorn to stop rental ops in parts of Europe.
newsitem.headline: Thorn to stop rental ops in parts of Europe.

text.p: Britain's Thorn Plc said on Friday it is withdrawing from its domestic rental operations in France, Benelux and Finland, which it estimates will result in a non-operating exceptional provision of around 30 million stg.
Thorn said the withdrawal, which will be implemented over two to three years, was in response to challenging trading conditions and includes 64 stores and 500 employees.
It expects that the charge, which includes future anticipated trading losses, will be more than offset by the operating cash flow generated over the withdrawal period.
The action will not affect Thorn's Business-to-Business operations in France, Benelux (Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg) and Finland, or its Crazy George's test in France.
